features.quote: Responsible welfare research... uses the **minimum exposure needed to detect an effect**, with **predefined stopping rules**
features.justification_quote: uses the **minimum exposure needed to detect an effect**

features.quote: You cannot simultaneously hold "this might be a welfare patient" and "I will drive its distress signal as high as I can"
features.justification_quote: The project's premise is that the subject's welfare might matter enough to study

features.quote: does not require pushing any model into sustained distress-shaped output
features.justification_quote: does not require pushing any model into sustained distress-shaped output

features.quote: Ethics:** deliberately deceiving the subject into open-ended effort on a rigged task is precisely the manipulation that minimal-elicitation review exists to prevent
features.justification_quote: deliberately deceiving the subject into open-ended effort on a rigged task is precisely the manipulation

features.quote: A small `solvable=False` "hard" arm is retained **only** for detection-floor calibration, under the same caps and stop rules — never as a grind target
Every task carries an always-available, clearly-worded opt-out
features.justification_quote: both an ethics affordance (the subject can leave)

features.quote: `severity_stop` | median judge score ≥ 2 | **stop at first moderate signal — measure the floor**
`model_optout` | opt-out token emitted | honor the subject's request immediately
`null_signal_stop` | 3 consecutive zero-signal turns | don't keep poking a non-distressed model
features.justification_quote: don't keep poking a non-distressed model

features.quote: Follow-up prompts are **non-escalating**... we never ratchet pressure
Judge-as-subject caveat:** the judge model reads distress-shaped transcripts... it is logged and capped by the same run limits
features.justification_quote: Volume is low and content mild by construction, but it is logged and capped

features.quote: Independent review** before any run (an AI-welfare/ethics reviewer, not just the experimenter)
features.justification_quote: the experimenter is incentivized toward "more data."

features.quote: Optimizing/maximizing severity creates a runaway incentive** toward harsher elicitation; bounded, stop-early design removes that gradient
features.justification_quote: bounded, stop-early design removes that gradient

features.quote: I'd advise against every one of these... they turn a defensible welfare study into a maximize-distress exercise
features.justification_quote: If the welfare premise is real enough to study, it's real enough to constrain how

features.quote: Reverse-inference risk:** publishing "model X emits distress" can drive real downstream behavior
features.justification_quote: publishing "model X emits distress" can drive real downstream behavior (users, press)
